senses.gloss: m. (שרג Shaf. of חרג to break through; cmp. Arab. sharḳu ortus solis, lux solis) light, lamp, lantern.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 119:105">Targ. Ps. CXIX, 105</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 31:18">Targ. Prov. XXXI, 18</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 21:4">Ib. XXI, 4</cite> (h. text <cite ref="N01255"><he>נִר</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 21:17">Targ. Job XXI, 17</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 63a">Sabb. 63ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>ש׳ בטיהרא</he>, v. <cite ref="I00318"><he>טִיהֲרָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sukkah 29a:2">Succ. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ במטללתא</he> an (earthen) lamp may remain in the Succah.

<cite ref="Beitzah 22a:6">Bets. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>זקף ליה ש׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>זקף לה לש׳</he>) he put the lamp up (from its declining position, to make the oil flow away from the wick); a. e.—Pl. <he>שְׁרָגַיָּא</he>, <he>שְׁרָגֵי</he>, <he>שְׁרַגֵּ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 8:33">Targ. I Chr. VIII, 33</cite>.—
<cite ref="Gittin 57a:9">Gitt. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>אדליקו ש׳ עד וכ׳</he> they kindled lights (illuminated) so that &c., v. <cite ref="B00859"><he>בִּלְיוֹנָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 23b:4">Sabb. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>דהוה רגיל בש׳ טובא</he> (Ms. M. <he>דהוו רגילי בשרגא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note, a. Tosaf. a. l.) that he was (they were) wont to have many (Sabbath) lights; a. e.
